text:
maria_marketing: Heads up — webinar tomorrow at 10am PT. Marketing needs final benchmark numbers + raw traces for the quantized 13B variant we plan to show. Primary asks: cold-start 95p latency, steady-state p50/p95, and a couple example KV-cache warmup traces. Also need artifact links and a short command we can paste into the slide so folks can repro quickly.

alex_runtime: Can you confirm which exact model name/quantization we should run? llama-2-13b-ql6 or the 13b-4bit-proto? Also, what's the target payload (tokens) and batch profile?

maria_marketing: @alex_runtime use "llama-2-13b-ql6" (the one in our catalog tagged redwood/llama2-13b-ql6). Payload: single prompt ~120 tokens, context length 512. Traffic profile: 70% single-request coldstart (no KV warm), 30% warm cached. We need both cold and warmed traces.

kevin_perf: Got it. We should do: 1) cold cohort (new model container, no KV), 2) warm cohort after 50 simulated warmups, 3) a burst profile with batches of 4. Anything else?

maria_marketing: Please include the burst-of-4 results and a tiny run with batching disabled (for the live demo we might show per-request latency). Also — we need the raw traces labeled with a run id and the seed, and a short README explaining how you warmed the cache.

ishaan: I'll kick off runs now. Using the perf harness: 

```bash
# run harness (example)
python perf_harness.py --model redwood/llama2-13b-ql6 --ctx 512 --prompt-sz 120 --batch-sizes 1,4 --warmups 50 --runs 200 --quantized ql6 --out-artifact run-1755554321-ql6.tar.gz
```

ishaan: Will tag artifacts like run-1755554321-ql6 and include: /traces/*.json, /summary/latency.csv, README.md with seed and warmup commands.

ci-bot: perf job started: job_id=perf-2024-11-07-0911-001, guarding exec on pool: runtime-quantized. Will notify on completion. :gear:

alex_runtime: Quick note on methodology we'll include in README: fixed-seed request order, separate VM for cold to avoid shared caches, 95p computed across request latencies after removing first 3 warmup responses. Also adding per-token breakdown from the runtime trace.

ishaan: Early results (first 50 cold runs): p50=210ms, p95=420ms, batch=1. Warmed after 50 warmups: p50=95ms, p95=170ms. Burst batch=4: p50=260ms, p95=480ms. I'll attach full CSV and traces when job finishes.

maria_marketing: This is perfect — can you include an explicit artifact link (S3 or internal URL) and a 1-2 line blurb we can paste into the slide describing the warmup procedure? e.g., "Warmup = 50 sequential requests with same prompt; KV-cache primed."

ishaan: Will do. Tentative artifact URL: https://artifacts.redwood/corp/perf/run-1755554321-ql6.tar.gz (I'll post final once job completes). Blurb: "Warmup: 50 sequential identical prompts to prime KV-cache; steady-state measured after warmup."

kevin_perf: One more for accuracy — we should include the exact harness command in the README and note CPU/GPU types and driver versions. I'll add GPU: A100-80GB, runtime v2.8.1, cuda 12.1.

maria_marketing: Awesome. ETA? we need final links + CSVs by 8:30am PT tomorrow.

ishaan: Job queued, estimated finish ~40 minutes. Will post artifacts and short slide blurb when done.

ci-bot: perf job completed: job_id=perf-2024-11-07-0911-001, artifacts uploaded: s3://artifacts.redwood/perf/run-1755554321-ql6.tar.gz

ishaan: Artifacts uploaded. Summary CSV: s3://artifacts.redwood/perf/run-1755554321-ql6/summary.csv Traces folder: s3://artifacts.redwood/perf/run-1755554321-ql6/traces/ README: s3://artifacts.redwood/perf/run-1755554321-ql6/README.md

alex_runtime: Placed a short methodology blurb in the README and a note about removal of the first 3 responses. Also included the exact harness command and reproducibility seed=42.

maria_marketing: Thanks team! I'll slot these into the deck and ping if we need a follow-up exact screenshot. :rocket:
